newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Perm says to issue $150-$200 mln Eurobond in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Perm says to issue $150-$200 mln Eurobond in Jan.

text.p: Russia's Perm region plans to issue $150-$200 million in Eurobonds in December or January via Morgan Stanley, a regional official said on Wednesday.
"The preliminary volume of the issue is $150-$200 million," First Deputy Governor Yuri Belousov told Reuters. "We plan to make the issue in December or January."
He said the region had chosen Morgan Stanley to lead manage the issue.
Belousov said the region, located in the Urals, had chosen Russian Bank Menatep as co-manager of the issue.
He also said the region planned to get an international credit rating in the autumn after the Russian Federation is expected to be upgraded.
Perm region is one of many Russian regions and territories seeking cheap foreign funds through Eurobonds.
The City of Moscow and St Petersburg have already made such issues.
